simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to טֶנֶא (H2935) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: טֶנֶא (ṭeneʼ) means a basket (of interlaced osiers) First listed occurrence: Deut 26 2.

definitions.full: H2935. tene טֶ֫נֶא noun masculine Deut 28:5 basket (Late Hebrew טְנִי is a large metal vessel) — absolute טֶ֫נֶא 26:4 , טֶ֑נֶא 26:2 ; suffix טַנְאֲךָ 28:5 , 17 ; in all a receptacle for products of soil (in last two || מִשְׁאֶרֶת ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root probably meaning to weave;
